name: TP4056
description: The TP4056 is a complete constant-current/constant-voltage linear charger for a single-cell lithium-ion/LiPo battery. The float (charge) voltage is fixed internally at 4.2V with 1% accuracy, and the charge current is set by a single resistor from PROG to ground (IBAT = VPROG/RPROG x 1200, giving 1000mA at 1.2k). It needs no external sense resistor, blocking diode, or MOSFET thanks to its internal PMOS architecture and reverse-discharge protection, and it includes thermal regulation that folds back current as the die heats. The chip terminates at C/10, supports automatic recharge, under-voltage lockout, a 2.9V trickle threshold, and NTC battery-temperature monitoring on the TEMP pin. Two open-drain status outputs (CHRG and STDBY) drive LEDs for charging and charge-complete indication.

pins.name: TEMP
pins.description: Battery temperature sense input from pack NTC; charging suspends if voltage is below 45% or above 80% of VCC. Tie to GND to disable temperature sensing.

pins.name: PROG
pins.description: Charge-current program and monitor; resistor RPROG from this pin to GND sets current (IBAT = VPROG/RPROG x 1200). Regulated to 1V in CC mode, 0.1V in precharge.

pins.name: VCC
pins.description: Positive input supply (4V to 8V); enters shutdown when within 30mV of BAT voltage

pins.name: BAT
pins.description: Battery connection; supplies charge current and regulates the 4.2V float voltage. Draws under 2uA in disable/sleep.

pins.name: STDBY
pins.description: Open-drain charge-status output; pulled low when the charge cycle completes, otherwise high impedance

pins.name: CHRG
pins.description: Open-drain charge-status output; pulled low while the battery is charging, otherwise high impedance

pins.name: CE
pins.description: Chip enable; logic high = normal operation, logic low = shutdown. TTL/CMOS compatible.

extra.exposed_pad: ESOP8/EMSOP8 has an exposed thermal pad on the underside connected to GND; solder it to the board GND copper for rated power dissipation
extra.termination: C/10 (charge current falls to 1/10 of programmed value)
extra.Icc (charge mode): 150uA typ (500uA max) @ RPROG=1.2k -- control-loop bias current, separate from the BAT charge current path
extra.Rth(JA): 125 C/W (ESOP8/EMSOP8, exposed pad soldered to PCB ground per the datasheet's thermal design note)

typical_application: USB-powered single-cell LiPo/Li-ion charger: 5V into VCC, a 1.2k PROG resistor for 1A, battery on BAT, and LEDs on CHRG/STDBY for charge and done indication.
gotchas: The ESOP8/EMSOP8 exposed pad on the package bottom is GND and must be soldered to the PCB ground plane; without it the part overheats and thermally folds back charge current.
Charge voltage is fixed at 4.2V (single-cell only); it cannot charge LiFePO4 (3.6V) or multi-cell packs.
If you do not use a pack thermistor, tie TEMP (pin 1) to GND or charging may be inhibited; the ubiquitous red TP4056 USB charger module often grounds TEMP for this reason.

This is the bare-chip pinout; the common TP4056 USB-C/micro-USB charger module adds the PROG resistor, status LEDs, USB connector, and often a separate DW01/FS8205 protection circuit which is NOT part of the TP4056 itself.
Many distributor and aggregator pinout tables for the TP4056 are wrong; this pinout is taken from the NanJing Top Power primary datasheet (REV 2.3).
CHRG and STDBY are open-drain: they sink LED current to GND and need the LED's other side pulled to VCC through a resistor.
